description: Ambiti Territoriali Organizzativi Ottimali di Protezione Civile - Ambiti Territoriali Organizzativi Ottimali di Protezione Civile is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by mappegis.regione.emilia-romagna.it. The optimal organisational territorial scope (hereinafter referred to as the ATO) for the performance of the civil protection function is an element introduced by the Civil Protection Code (Legislative Decree No 1/2018), for which the geography must be defined in terms of the territories included and, at the same time, the organisational criteria thereof ... Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Optimal Organizational Territorial Areas of Civil Protection - Optimal Organizational Territorial Areas of Civil Protect" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support emergency planning and critical-facility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
